import os
p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-2/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-4ecf9682.py'
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the non-background pattern and the zero placeholder; mirror pattern horizontally into it.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v not in (bg,0)]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    pattern=[row[c0:c1+1] for row in grid[r0:r1+1]]
    zeros=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==0]
    zr0,zr1=min(r for r,c in zeros),max(r for r,c in zeros)
    zc0,zc1=min(c for r,c in zeros),max(c for r,c in zeros)
    for i in range(len(pattern)):
        for j in range(len(pattern[0])):
            out[zr0+i][zc0+j]=pattern[i][len(pattern[0])-1-j]
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
